note: Add-only. These reason codes are the only values the rules module may put in ruleResult.reason. The Engine Lead copies them into docs/engine/diagnostics.md when that registry exists. source is always "rules". The HUD locale key is rules.<code>.

codes.summary: The command was applied as requested.
The spawn key is not in the current sim.
The ship is already destroyed.
The entity is a fighter or other non-ship. Duel entry points accept class ship and class pf.
A numeric input is negative.
A box count is not an integer.
A fixed-point quantity is finer than the provisional milli-unit scale.
A shield index is outside 0..5.
The system key is not present on this ship.
The energy allocation names a draw the duel slice does not recognise.
The slotIndex is not a mount on this ship.
The weapon or mode is outside the Phase 2 duel (drones, and any mode other than normal, overload or proximity).
The mount has not finished charging or arming.
Fire control was not paid for the standing allocation.
The target bearing is outside the mount's mapped arc.
The target is beyond the weapon's last range band, or beyond photonMaxRange.
The mount has no boxes left.
The turn-mode letter has no playtest rate. Emitted once when the hull is spawned. Speed and yaw then use the documented fallback and are kept.
Crew is below the minimum. Helm and fire are refused. Power and repair commands still run.
Requested energy exceeded generation plus battery. Lower-priority draws were reduced.
Ordered speed was reduced to the acceleration limit.
The hull cannot move or yaw. Ordered speed or yaw was set to 0.
setShields was above the facing maximum and was clamped to that maximum.
damageShield removed only the points remaining on that facing. The command does not bleed into internals.
repairSystem restored fewer boxes than requested because the system reached its original count.
repairSystem was asked for a positive number of boxes and the system was already at its original count.
Some requested internal points could not be placed. The ship is destroyed when the excess pool is also empty.
A weapon request was reduced to the energy the mount (and capacitor, when the hypothesis flag is on) can still store.
Shield reinforcement was reduced by the per-turn cap or by remaining shield room.
The heading change was reduced to the turn mode's per-tick yaw limit.
The shot was fired and missed because the defender's ECM beat the attacker's ECCM.
The ship has no sensor, scanner, or special-sensor boxes, so it cannot buy ECM or ECCM.
The ECM and ECCM request was cut to the sensor boxes still on the ship.
This mount has no overload arming cost, so it cannot leave normal or proximity arming.
The hull has no tractor boxes.
A tractor cannot be locked onto the ship that is projecting it.
The tractor bid did not beat the target, or a live beam lost the contest or the range.
Cloak cost is empty. This hull has no cloak.
Weapons are locked while the cloak is engaging, on, or disengaging.
The target is cloaked and this ship does not currently detect it.
The battery could not pay the cloak's rules-turn cost, so the cloak dropped.
The tractor bid was cut to the tractor boxes on the hull.
